[= attha 2 qv; AMg id; this form used mainly in cpds, very frequently ifc ], matter; meaning, sense ; Paṭis I 174, 7 (ken’ ~ena buddho, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se atthena); Kv 164, 31 (ken’ ~enā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee atthena); Sadd 2, 5 (ken’ ~ena dhātu); — aṭṭha in Ee at As 31, 11 is prob. wr for aṭṭa 2 qv ; — aṭṭha in Ee at Sv 935, 23 is wr for aḍḍha 1 qv ; — ifc see app’-; — °’- uppatti f. , an occurrence giving rise to the preaching of the dhamma; Mp I 18, 14 (ayaṃ desanā … katamāya ~iyā desitā ti, Be, Se so; Ce katarāya; Ee katarāyaṃ); Ud-a 30, 11 (suttadesanāya vatthubhūtassa atthassa uppatti atthuppatti, atthuppatti eva ~i, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee suttadesanassa atthassa … atthuppatti eva atthuppattiko va) = It-a I 35, 30 ( Be, Se so; Ce atthuppatti yeva atthuppattiko; Ee atthuppatti eva atthuppattikā); Pj II 46, 17 (sabbasuttānaṃ catubbidhā uppatti attajjhāsayato parajjhāsayato ~ito pucchāvasito cā ti); Vv-a 5, 6 (paṭhamavatthussa ayaṃ ~i); Ap-a 275, 18 (tayo vinicchaye ~iṃ katvā); Bv-a 295, 29 (imissā ~iyā Vessantarajātakaṃ kathesi); — °’- uppattika , mfn. , arising from an occurrence ; Ud-a 29, 26 (attajjhāsayo parajjhāsayo pucchāvasiko ~o ti cattāro suttanikkhepā veditabbā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee atthuppattiko) = Bv-a 64, 14 ; — °- kathā , f. [ cf S. arthavāda], “exposition of the meaning”, commentary (as opposed to the text, pāḷi ; the early commentaries used by Buddhaghosa etc and the commentaries compiled by Buddhaghosa etc) ; Ja I 345, 15 (parinibbute pana bhagavati saṅgītikārakā … tīṇi padāni ~aṃ āropetvā); 488, 29´ (pāḷiyaṃ pana phalaṃ pāpetī ti likhanti taṃ vyañjanaṃ ~āya n’ atthi); V 413, 16 (purimanayo va bahūsu ~āsu āgato); VI 279, 29´ (~āyaṃ pana hotu suṅkaṃ mahārājā ti pāṭho); Vism 107, 16 (idaṃ … n’ eva pāḷiyaṃ na ~āyaṃ āgataṃ kevalaṃ ācariyamatānusārena vuttaṃ); Sp 41, 13 (sabbaṃ buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhi saddhiṃ ~āya); 280, 30 (bhagavato hi adhippāyaṃ ñatvā Upālittherādīhi ~ā ṭhapitā); 1273, 8* (pāḷiṃ ~aṃ c’ eva oloketvā vicakkhaṇo saṅghike paccaye evaṃ appamatto vibhājaye); Ps I 1, 21* (atthappakāsanatthaṃ ~ā ādito vasīsatehi pañcahi yā saṅgītā anusaṅgītā ca pacchā pi); Mhv 33:100 (piṭakattayapāliṃ ca tassā ~aṃ pi ca mukhapāṭhena ānesuṃ pubbe bhikkhū); 37:234 (kātuṃ ~aṃ mama potthake detha sabbe ti); Sadd 541, 12 (attho kathīyati etāyā ti ~ā); 739, 25 (pāḷiyaṃ … ~āsu pana …); — ~-muttaka, mfn. , independent of the commentary ; As 107, 20 (idaṃ ~-muttakaṃ ācariyānaṃ mataṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~-vuttakaṃ); 223, 33 (ayaṃ ettha ~-muttako ekassa ācariyassa mativinicchayo); — see also aṭṭhakathika.
aṭṭhā aor. 3 sg. of tiṭṭhati qv .
CPD: 2 aṭṭha , numeral [ sa. aṣṭa(n): aṣṭau], eight; nom. acc. pl. mfn. aṭṭha puggalā, Sn 227; ~ parisă, AN lV 307, 14 ; ~ vatthūni, Pj ll 469, 5 = Dhp-a lV 186, 1 ; aṭṭhiindriyāni, Dhs 58, 161; ~ nāma kiṃ, Khp lV (8); instr, abl. pl. aṭṭhahi, Mil 291, 12 ; also atthāhi ( abl ), Ja l 414, 5 * = lll 207, 14 * (catubbhi . . . m . . . soḷa- sāhi, v. l. attha(b)hi); ( dat. ) gen. pl. atthannaṃ, Sn p. 87, 1 ; Sv l 1, 9 *; loc. pl. aṭṭhasu, SN lV 325, 1 ; — repeated in distributive sense aṭṭhiaṭṭha = eight of each, eight every time; Dhp-a ll 41, 2 (~ kahāpaṇe labhati); Mhv V 249 (~ there 'macce ca pesayi); Mp l 172, 22 (~ katvā); Abhidh-av 52, 1 * (evaṃ ~ katvāna); cf. Ja V 450, 19 *; — aṭṭha kahāpaṇā is generally used to denote a ( low ) price or salary, or ( the lowest ) amount of penalty: ~ahi kahāpaṇehi, Mil 291, 12 ( scil. kese vikkiṇitvā); ~ kahāpaṇe dāpesi, Ja lV 138, 1 (= nahāpita-dāyo, ib. 18); ~ kahāpaṇe daṇḍāpessāmi, Ja l 483, 21 ; — very frequently used in numbering groups of dhammā, of which exx. are found AN lV 150—-350 ( the Atthaka-nipāta; see lndex AN Vl 185—87), DN lll 254—262, 284—288, Vin V 136—-7; further see e.g. uposatha-kamma, kappa- rukkha, kāmāvacara-kusalacitta, tāpasa-pabbajjā, pāna, purisa-puggala, purisabhūmi, petī, Malla- pāmokkha, rūpa, lobha, vata-pada, vatta, vatthu, vimokkha, saṃvega-vatthu, samāpatti, and comp.s below. — lfc. v. addha °, satta °.
aṭṭhā , 1 . = 2 aṭṭha in comp., see next etc. — 2. aor. = aṭṭhāsi, see tiṭṭhati.
NCP: attha 1 m rarely neuter aim, purpose, goal; advantage, profit, benefit. use, need, want (+ instr.). affair, concern, business; problem; thing, matter; (with verbs of saying, asking, etc. often simply) this, that. practical affairs, policy; a legal case. meaning, sense; very often in commentaries at end of explained (esp. paraphrased) passages as ti attho: this is the meaning; in association with dhamma, attha expresses the goal as opposed to the doctrine; practical affairs as opposed to spiritual matters; the practical application and result as opposed to the theory; the interpretation as opposed to the text. attha 2 masculine neuter sets (of the sun or moon) goes out, disappears, is extinguished.
